verdict.rationale: Greptile's docs describe a learning system that builds memory from team feedback: 👍/👎 reactions and replies teach it what matters, and after 2-3 weeks it stops commenting on things the team doesn't care about. It also indexes existing rule files (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, cursor rules), supports custom rules scoped to team-owned directories, and lets users view, search and create coding patterns via MCP, all of which carry into future reviews. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the learned memory measurably changes future reviews, and detail on how learned preferences from past review decisions are stored, inspected or edited.
